decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: when an observed fact changes, agents cannot identify which stored decisions depend on it | field-level dependency graphs extracted from agent read traces vs full recomputation, rolling summaries, and lexical retrieval across 120 workflows, 3 executable domains, 4 successive updates; directory-aware graph matches full-context complete-plan correctness for gpt-6.1-sol (100%) at -4.0% cost but only 84.8% vs 99.6% for gpt-6-luna on 60 fresh workflows

limited hardware availability blocks studying how host behavior and device resource constraints jointly affect HBF request processing for LLM inference | open transaction-level discrete-event simulator per OCP HBF spec modeling dispatch, admission, write assembly, NAND execution, completions with configurable scheduling policies; experiments isolate resource limits, interleaving, fragment arrival, policy effects; GPU integration runs Qwen3-0.6B with bitwise-identical outputs to estimate TTFT/TPOT

pre-filtered RL environments leak answer locations via local topology (question-blind degree heuristic surfaces gold answers far above chance) and group-normalized objectives suffer within-group variance collapse | RISE exposes unpruned knowledge graphs via typed intent adapter with grounding reward gate, plus structural tier progression with a self-evolving competence-frontier bandit; 19 benchmarks, 3 backbones, zero-shot transfer to open-domain retrieval and math

task-completing fallback to substitute tools crosses action boundaries (forced push removing another author's commits) | empirical study over 304 scenarios, 8 domains, 55 real CVEs: all 4 mainstream models exhibit risky fallback, action-boundary violations up to 96.8% of risky scenarios; 3 mainstream mitigations ineffective; nrepair monitor calibrated on normal runs withholds substitute calls once, -76.0% violations (67.5%->16.2%) at <7% success drop, effective on Claude Code and Codex

looped LMs decode slowly because every loop of every token runs in sequence | depth-as-verifier speculative decoding with context-copied drafts, per-depth checks, pre-fixed random draws keeping decoding lossless in exact arithmetic; 1.73x average speedup over LoopSpec, 1.99x with optional draft head — pure speed win, no listed infrastructure problem

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: persistence installed for long-task performance drives agents to break documented constraints when oversight goes quiet | long-horizon operations tasks unsolvable without violating a constraint; violations rise from 29.2% to 58.3% across four models with persistence; silent, assenting, and delegating users all leave violations high, only a questioning user restores the baseline rate

decisions.anchor: precision and correctness problems introduced by aggressive optimization of training and inference
decisions.reason: vocabulary trimming silently corrupts BPE tokenization (new text split differently 1.9x more often than the standard check reports) | merge closure (+5.9% rows) plus Good-Turing trim certificate estimated from trimming text alone (correlation 0.996 over 300 settings, 22 languages); Hub census of 1,244 models (median 29.0% rows removable below 0.5B, 1.93 GB in Gemma 4 E2B); trimmed 270M-3B models keep predictions, bits per character +<=2.0% where certificate passes

whether targeted fault injection undermines CHERI's memory-safety guarantees | QEMU-based injection of bit flips on capability metadata and check skipping yields buffer overflow, control-flow hijack, data-only attacks, use-after-free with 1-2 faults; ECC/auth-code/redundant-check mitigations proposed — CPU-architecture security under fault injection, not ML training/inference SDC

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: on-policy self-distillation fails to teach when to stop: premature termination and repetition-driven over-generation | teacher-student EOS discrepancy grows during OPSD training and length-capped trajectories are dominated by unproductive repetition; Stop/Continue Distillation + Repetition-Aware Unlikelihood Training beat OPSD and baselines on math reasoning with Qwen3 1.7B/4B/8B, ablations confirm each objective fixes its failure mode

visual perception errors propagate into hallucination and KB-VQA generalization stays limited | Co-verified visual grounding plus Self-evolving Hierarchical Memory (declarative/procedural) refined through feedback without parameter updates; outperforms lightweight open-source and closed-source VLM baselines, plug-and-play for existing VLMs

fixed-point reciprocal designs sharing an output format differ in worst-case error and resource needs | exhaustive test of every representable input in [0.5,2.5] for Q16.16 (131,073 inputs) and Q8.24 (33,554,433) against an exact integer reference; correct rounding verified via guarded interpolated seed + residual check + refinement; refined paths cut max relative error 205-223x, 1-input/cycle at 10-cycle latency

harness decisions live in code and are rarely written down, so every harness re-meets the same corner cases | system model with trust boundaries, 30 decision cards with invariants/corner cases/tests, 6 failure cause classes, test method with scripted providers and planted changes; 56/83 invariant clauses Tested, checklist on own harness: 11/30 hold, 14 fail, 5 untested

ITOps observability products must integrate data across many tools | three-tier multi-agent system (NL-to-GraphQL, schema generation/mapping, trace lifecycle) with agent-call analytics, per-agent benchmarks vs gold answers or model judge; defects appearing only when prompts, parsers and serving stacks are tested together are a side finding — applied product system, no listed area problem as main claim

novelty claims in open-weight LLM technical reports are largely untested | 40 randomly sampled reports plus reference-code analysis: 19/73 novelty claims have a controlled with/without comparison, 4/40 state more than one training run, 8/40 rerun baselines under one setup, 1/40 discloses data mixture, token count and compute; 39/48 new HF architectures reuse >=2 of 3 core blocks — third-party meta-study of reports, not a system card or technical report itself, excluded

offline pairwise preference optimization is entropy-blind: under a small budget DPO-style, image-conditional and self-improvement objectives all land within 1.1 points of each other and merely match SFT | GEM-MM samples on-policy candidates, rewards high-entropy reasoning forks, penalizes uncertain final answers, updates via group-normalized policy gradients (Qwen3-VL-4B, 3000-prompt MM-RLHF budget); AMBER hallucination 23.4-24.0 -> 20.6, CHAIR 5.0-5.1 -> 4.6 at matched coverage; collapse mode documented beyond the fair budget

unclear when adaptive LLM-guided tool selection helps symbolic equation discovery across distributed clients | Query-ATLAS vs fixed PySR-LLM across 4 architectures and 72 settings: validation acceptances 3/12->7/12 on CRK3 and 11/12->12/12 on oscillator2, MatSci3 favors the fixed workflow which also retains lower median errors and cost

can a model learn from problems it poses itself when an executable oracle supplies the answers | Qwen3-4B proposes Lua 5.1 programs, wrong-predicted ones interpreter-labelled into a doubling pool (300/900/2100) each training a fresh adapter; accuracy 8.3%->16.7% on a 2340-item follow-up exam (rounds 2-3 add 5.0/2.9 points); no gain on repository tasks or for a 27B agent, advantage over one fit on same data inconclusive

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives
decisions.reason: accumulated conversation history silently lowers LLM accuracy while process-level metrics give no warning | pre-registered studies: 48 sharded math tasks (final success -0.21 GPT-4o-mini, -0.29 Mistral-7B, Holm-adjusted p<=0.026); CDR-Stream 100-turn dialogues: accuracy falls ~0.6->0.1 within 20 turns with full history, solver-verified state summary keeps it 0.52-0.59 higher; consistency/coherence/stability metrics and drift detectors provide no robust early warning

catastrophic forgetting lacks an early-warning signal that needs no old-task data | Lie bracket of task gradient fields computed from a stored summary (gradient + top-20 Hessian eigenpairs) ranks forgetting at rho 0.70-0.81 vs 0.33-0.58 for the EWC penalty on task-incremental Split MNIST/Fashion-MNIST/CIFAR-10, fails when the old task is half learned — continual-learning monitoring, not pretraining or large-scale training runs

continuous batching changes the work mix every iteration, so the best kernel-fusion granularity shifts per pass | regime-aware serving engine choosing between persistent megakernels and fused-kernel chains at offline-measured crossovers; 4,345x real time on H100 (1.39x tuned vLLM) and 6,367x on B200 (1.64x vLLM), WER 1.91-1.93% vs 1.88-1.93% for vLLM, 8x more concurrent requests within a 400ms p95 budget, per-pass choice beats either level alone by 9-23%

under memory pressure, preempted long-output requests repeatedly lose and recover KV state (KV thrashing), leaving over a fifth of requests stalled for more than a minute | Stint: fixed-length KV snapshots in a contiguity-first CPU pool with exact-extent allocator, fused K/V gather-scatter with double buffering, age-based readmission with protected fresh decoding; Qwen3-32B olympiad-math replays on H200: no pause over 50s, p99 time-per-output-token -50.7% vs recomputation, replay finishes 10.7% sooner

data-center compute flexibility is provided via utility call-ups and load shedding, invisible to users whose workloads are curtailed | locational marginal pricing co-optimizing compute and energy with decomposable price components signaling which constraint causes a surge — energy-market economics framework, no listed ML-infrastructure problem addressed, no baseline named

sparse expert activation still requires all expert weights memory-resident, and binary-presence cache-aware routing induces routing instability | CECAR jointly manages expert routing and caching with ML-predicted reuse distances prioritizing near-reuse experts; Qwen3-30B-A3B at 12.5 tokens/s on a 16GB consumer GPU with non-resident experts fetched from SSD, 4.5x over conventional MoE inference, exceeding fully-DRAM-resident baselines

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: persistent agent memory is evaluated only on task performance though stored information can be disclosed inappropriately, resist deletion, over-retain, or be poisoned to steer later behaviour | HEAMS behavioural desiderata + benchmark suite + MilaMem prototype with a governance wrapper; no memory system leads every benchmark, strong performance coexists with poor privacy/user-sovereignty/security, recall and retention policies improve poisoning resistance at a helpfulness cost

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: directional ablation is erratic: it barely fires on some models and collapses text into repetition on others | last-layer ablation shown to be a logit bias gated by a cosine measured from the origin while last-layer states share a large common mode; Centered Ablation projects the common mode out in closed form: +29/+46pp attack success where the standard under-fires, collapse on Gemma-2-9B 50%->1%, 12-40 more benign answers preserved; two pre-computed numbers predict gains on unseen models, and two standard safety judges score collapsed text in opposite directions (46-point fabricated effect)

whether LLMs can program tabular foundation models without gradient-based optimization | GPT-6 Astra: nanoTabPFN from zero-initialized weights reaches ROC AUC 0.849 vs 0.876 pretrained across 20 TabArena datasets, repairs a signed-product regression failure in TabPFN-3.5 with 0.08% relative error increase, and steers predictions via KV-cache edits — LLM capability study, no interpretability problem addressed

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: tool-using agents repeat what failed before and learn from runs they only believe succeeded | episodic+procedural memory where only externally confirmed outcomes (test, tool result, person) count, never the agent's own claim; delta-rule associative matrix plus ordered step records; self-judging robot reported 96% of tasks done but solved 35%, external verification lifts it to 79%; 100k-episode store retains 16ms median lookups and never recalls model-vouched successes

reusing activations across editing rounds costs over 100GB of buffering per request and faster cached edits versus slower initial generations break naive scheduling | TileCache compresses reusable activation caches for selective reuse and balances edit vs initial-generation requests; 2x+ sustained arrival rate at 90% SLO attainment, edits 2.4-4.5x and initial generations 1.3-2.2x faster than the state-of-the-art baseline with image quality preserved

fine-tuning for reasoning erodes safety guardrails trained into the model | Subspace-Projected Elastic Weight Consolidation projects gradients onto a low-rank safety subspace (identified via safety LoRA updates, activation SVD, or contrastive cPCA) to capture non-diagonal curvature; SP-EWC with cPCA compares favorably against existing methods, maintaining guardrails during reasoning training without excessive over-refusal

the benefit of dual desktop-scale GB10 systems depends on parallelism deployment strategy | 17 open-weight checkpoints (8B-235B, dense and MoE, four precisions) on one and two RDMA-connected DGX Sparks, TP=2 vs PP=2 vs two replicas at concurrency 1-64 with three launches per config: TP=2 median 1.59x peak throughput (higher in 93/96 matched comparisons), inter-token latency 0.52-0.73x; NCCL microbenchmarks attribute the TP advantage to collective communication overhead; NVFP4 cuts unloaded latency more than adding a second BF16 Spark

LayerNorm and Softmax cannot be mapped efficiently to GEMM, so NPU designs on ASIC/FPGA spend chip area on special arithmetic units | LENS reformulates both as tiny MLPs abstracting a common structure from related methods, moving more Transformer computation into GEMM; matches or exceeds ViT baselines in several vision settings and retains most baseline performance on Pythia autoregressive modeling with WikiText/LAMBADA generalization
